dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs ta ikt 02 ltf testing the performance of innovative inspection techniques for rising mains sewage pressure pipes

description: Beenen, TON at Stichting RIONED publishes ground-truth defect descriptions and inspection results for wastewater pressure pipes through Co-UDlabs. A full-scale IKT test system contains different pipe materials and imposed damage. Records compare actual and reported defect type, location, dimensions and size, with manufacturer-reported inspection-system application limits. Proprietary raw sensor signals are explicitly excluded. Coverage is the IKT large test facility in Germany; observation dates are not given. Zenodo provides a measuring-data ZIP archive with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is reported inspection classifications cannot reproduce proprietary ultrasonic/acoustic processing because those raw measurements were not supplied. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
